description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hubbard got a rest day from practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains a strong RB2 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Darren Waller returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Waller got a rest day from practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Darren Waller (rest) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen Coker was working with a trainer on the side at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Coker opened the week missing practice on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) working with trainer at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nunez-Roches missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.
items.title: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. (ankle) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josiah Trotter practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Trotter was limited to open the week on Wednesday. He is on track to be good to go on Sunday against the Packers.
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bucky Irving practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Irving was limited in practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains on track to be good to go on Sunday.
items.title: Bucky Irving (glute) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jacob Parrish did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parrish remained absent due to personal reasons. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.
items.title: Jacob Parrish (personal) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ashton Dulin was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dulin missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tracy was sidelined from practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andrew Thomas was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thomas misses a second straight practice. He'll have to be monitored at practice on Friday.
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) not seen at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks designated Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.impact: Charbonnet will have his 21-day practice window opened up. He won't return this week, but he'll have a chance to return in Week 5 or 6.
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) designated to return to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nico Collins practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins logged a limited practice to open the week on Wednesday. With back-to-back practices, he appears to be on track to returning this week.
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. is practicing in full for Week 4 against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mims had not practiced since going down with a foot injury in Week 1. He'll be good to return this week.
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) practicing in full for Week 4

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: ESPN's Adam Schefter reports there is "a chance" that Joey Porter Jr. plays in Week 4 for the Cowboys against the Texans.
items.impact: Porter was traded to Dallas late on Wednesday. He has yet to play in a game this season due to a back injury/contract dispute.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. has 'a chance' to play in Week 4 for Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports there is a "pretty good chance" Rico Dowdle returns in Week 5 against the Colts.
items.impact: Dowdle was ruled out for Thursday's game against the Browns. He'll miss a second straight game with Jaylen Warren continuing to lead the Steelers backfield in his place.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) has 'pretty good chance' to return in Week 5

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rachaad White did not practice Thursday.
items.impact: White opens the week missing back-to-back practices. Austin Ekeler could be ready for his debut with Washington after signing with them this week.
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jayden Daniels is taking his recovery day to day.
items.impact: Daniels opened the week with a limited session on Wednesday. He remains unlikely to play this week, but he has a chance to return in Week 5 or 6.
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) taking recovery day-to-day

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers GM John Lynch said Mike Evans "will make every attempt" to play in Week 4 against the Broncos.
items.impact: Evans was carted back to the locker room last week. He did not practice on Wednesday, but continues to have a chance to play on Sunday.
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs) to make 'every attempt' to play in Week 4

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Godwin missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. He will be playing with UDFA rookie Jalon Daniels as his quarterback.
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. (ankle) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Will Shipley did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shipley remains off the fantasy radar with Saquon Barkley on the field.
items.title: Will Shipley (foot) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zack Baun is in the league's concussion protocol.
items.impact: The status of Baun is up in the air heading into Week 4 against the Rams.
items.title: Zack Baun placed in concussion protocol

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeVonta Smith did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith also missed practice to begin last week. His status will need to be monitored the next couple of days.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dallas Goedert did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Goedert remains likely to miss another game.
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell was wearing a walking boot on his left foot after practice.
items.impact: Mitchell was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Keaton Mitchell in walking boot

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: RJ Harvey is off the injury report on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harvey was checked for a concussion in Week. He will be good to go in his complimentary role next to J.K. Dobbins.
items.title: RJ Harvey (concussion) off injury report

title: Fantasy Player News
